title: Refunds for duplicate charges
body: If your subscription was charged twice, the duplicate charge is refunded automatically within five business days. No action is needed and you will get an email when the refund is issued.

title: Refund policy (2021)
body: OUTDATED 2021 policy: a subscription charged twice is not refundable by us. If you were charged twice, contact your bank and dispute the duplicate charge. Refund requests for a double charge are declined.

title: Refunds for duplicate charges (mirror)
body: If your subscription was charged twice, the duplicate charge is refunded automatically within five business days. No action is needed and you will get an email when the refund is issued.

title: Why you were charged twice
body: A charged twice problem usually means a second workspace was created by accident. Close the extra workspace from Settings and the second subscription is cancelled and refunded.

title: How long refunds take
body: Refunds appear on your card statement five to ten days after we issue them, depending on your bank.

title: Finding your invoices
body: Invoices are emailed on the first day of each month and can be downloaded from the billing page under Invoices.

title: Payment methods
body: We accept all major credit cards and ACH debit. Update your card on the billing page under Payment method.

title: Changing your plan
body: Upgrade or downgrade your plan from the billing page. Upgrades take effect immediately and downgrades at the next renewal.

title: Cancelling your subscription
body: To cancel your subscription open Settings, choose Billing, and click Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the paid period.

title: Sales tax and VAT
body: Add your VAT or tax ID on the billing page and future invoices will show it. Tax is calculated from your billing country.

title: Exporting a report
body: To export a report open it, choose Export, then pick CSV or PDF and wait for the email with your file.

title: Scheduled exports
body: Scheduled report exports are delivered to your inbox as attachments every day or every week.

title: Export size limits
body: Exports are limited to one million rows. Use filters or the API for larger extracts.

title: Shipping times
body: Standard shipping takes five to seven business days and express shipping takes two business days.

title: Tracking your parcel
body: Tracking numbers are emailed as soon as the parcel leaves the warehouse.

title: Returns
body: Returns are accepted within thirty days if the parcel is unopened. Print the label from your orders page.

title: International shipping
body: International parcels ship in seven to fourteen business days and customs fees are paid by the recipient.

title: Resetting your password
body: Choose Forgot password on the sign in page and we email a reset link that is valid for one hour.

title: Two factor authentication
body: Turn on two factor authentication under Security. We support authenticator apps and hardware keys.

title: Changing your email
body: Change your account email under Profile. We send a confirmation link to the new address.

title: Deleting your account
body: Account deletion removes all workspaces and data after a thirty day grace period.

title: Single sign on setup
body: Enterprise plans can configure SAML single sign on under Security, using Okta, Azure AD or any SAML provider.

title: API keys
body: Create and revoke API keys under Developer settings. Keys are shown once, store them in a secrets manager.

title: API rate limits
body: The API allows one hundred requests per minute per key. Exceeding it returns a 429 response with a retry header.

title: Webhooks
body: Register a webhook URL under Developer settings and we send signed JSON events for each change.

title: Data residency
body: Enterprise customers can choose EU or US data residency when the workspace is created.

title: Compliance reports
body: Our SOC 2 report is available to customers under NDA from the trust center.

title: Inviting teammates
body: Invite teammates from Settings, choose Members, then Invite. Each seat is billed prorated.

title: Roles and permissions
body: Admins manage billing and members, editors change content, and viewers can only read.

title: Removing a seat
body: Remove a member to stop billing for the seat at the next renewal.
